subject: Azure Marketplace: Offer publish ops checklist & co-sell sequencing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@microsoft.com>, Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@microsoft.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Azure Marketplace: Offer publish ops checklist & co-sell sequencing

Hi Anna / Marketplace Ops team,

Thanks again for the quick intake call this morning. Per our conversation I'm sending a compact ops checklist and the minimal artifacts we need to clear technical validation and get the co-sell intake linked to Contoso's renewal opportunity. High-level asks:

- Confirm that the offer manifest we attached is acceptable for validation (schema v3).
- Confirm the identity proof that maps our publisher tenant to the Contoso co-sell record.
- Confirm SKU-to-plan mapping guidance so we can populate the co-sell intake form (Contoso has 3 SKUs: dev, standard, enterprise).
- Schedule a 30-min validation window (quick screen of the offer portal + manifest parsing) this week if possible.

Attachments: offer_manifest_v1.json, identity_proof_marissa.pdf, co-sell-intake-contoso.xlsx (stubbed)

Notes for internal team (CCed): Aditya/Vivek — after Anna confirms the manifest shape we'll push an updated manifest and tag a new package in publisher portal (I want to avoid repeated resubmits). I also included the DocuSign link for the co-sell consent we started.

Next step: Anna, can you propose a 30-min slot Wed/Thu morning PST? We'll invite Contoso's Isaac and map SKUs during the call.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior GTM Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415 555 1769

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Offer publish ops checklist & co-sell sequencing

Marissa — quick internal follow-up before we send final manifest:

1) Manifest: I validated the sku/plan blocks vs schema v3. Small diffs: we should use "skuId" (GUID) not the human-facing code in the JSON blob; I updated a local copy.
2) Identity proof: the PDF has the correct tenant GUID but missing the org verification letter. If Marketplace Ops needs org letter + screenshot of subscription, we should attach that.
3) Co-sell intake: Isaac's team prefers the mapping to include per-SKU list price and commitment tiers. I flagged the estimated price columns in the attached workbook.

I can stand up a 30-min triage slot on Wed 10:00-10:30 PST if that works for Anna. If Marketplace Ops wants the manifest pre-validated, I can run it through our internal linter and push a corrected bundle by EOD today.

Action items (internal):
- Aditya: produce manifest_v1.1 with skuId GUIDs and upload to SharePoint. (ETA: today EOD)
- Vivek: pull org verification letter from Legal and attach to identity_proof. (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- Marissa: confirm call time with Anna and Isaac.

–Aditya
Senior Technical Program Manager, Marketplace Integrations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@microsoft.com>, Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@microsoft.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Isaac Chen <isaac@contoso.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Offer publish ops checklist & co-sell sequencing

Anna — following up with an updated plan and attachments (see below). Aditya linted the manifest and replaced the SKU codes with GUIDs (attached as offer_manifest_v1.1). Vivek is pulling the org verification letter now and will add it to the identity bundle.

I also opened the DocuSign envelope for the co-sell consent; link attached in the metadata. For the call we propose Wed 10:00-10:30 PST — tentative invite sent to Marketplace Ops and Contoso's Isaac. Agenda: manifest parse & portal preview (15m), SKU mapping & co-sell tagging (10m), next steps & timelines (5m).

Attachments: offer_manifest_v1.1.json (updated), co-sell-intake-contoso.xlsx (with pricing columns marked)

Quoted for context:
> On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 11:03 AM Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com> wrote:
>
> Marissa — quick internal follow-up before we send final manifest:
> 1) Manifest: I validated the sku/plan blocks vs schema v3. Small diffs: we should use "skuId" (GUID) not the human-facing code in the JSON blob; I updated a local copy.
> 2) Identity proof: the PDF has the correct tenant GUID but missing the org verification letter. If Marketplace Ops needs org letter + screenshot of subscription, we should attach that.
> 3) Co-sell intake: Isaac's team prefers the mapping to include per-SKU list price and commitment tiers. I flagged the estimated price columns in the attached workbook.

Looking forward to the call — can you confirm the portal preview requirement (do we need an entitlement proof or will the manifest parse suffice for the validation pass)?

Best,
Marissa

From: Anna Li <anna.li@microsoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@microsoft.com>, Isaac Chen <isaac@contoso.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Offer publish ops checklist & co-sell sequencing

Thanks Marissa — the updated manifest looks much cleaner. A few quick notes and next steps from Marketplace Ops: 

- Manifest: offer_manifest_v1.1 passes schema validation. Please include the SKU price tiers in the plan metadata (we can map to co-sell buckets from there).
- Identity bundle: we need the org verification letter + screenshot of the publisher subscription in the portal. Vivek, if you can drop those into the SharePoint link Anna provided, mark them as PROD evidence.
- Portal preview: not required for the initial technical gate. We'll run the manifest parser and confirm a validation pass; a portal preview is only scheduled for publishing failures.
- Call: Wed 10:00 PST works for our side — invite accepted. We'll use this slot to align SKU->co-sell tags and confirm DocuSign flow for co-sell consent.

For Contoso (Isaac) — during the call we'll ask for the expected committed seat tiers by SKU so the co-sell intake can be completed accurately. If you have the numbers in advance, please paste them in the meeting notes.

I'll mark this thread as validation-in-progress and update when the parser returns the final verdict (typically within 24 hours after the call if no additional fixes are needed).

Best,
Anna Li
Marketplace Technical Program Manager
Microsoft Corp.
anna.li@microsoft.com
